title: President Obama Arrives at Tinker AFB to View Tornado Damaged Area - TV Story
description: President Barack Obama arrived at Tinker Air Force Base, Oklahoma aboard Air Force One to get a first hand view of the destruction caused by the EF-5 tornado that struck Moore, Oklahoma on May 20. Before the President departed the base for Moore, he met with first responders and members of the Tinker family whose homes were destroyed in the storm. Available in High Definition.
